title: Particle-to-mole scaler
question: How do count, mass, ideal-gas volume, and Faraday charge depend on one declared amount of substance?
predictionPrompt: If amount of substance doubles while molar mass, temperature, pressure, and signed charge number remain fixed, predict which dependent count, mass, ideal-gas volume, and Faraday charge outputs double.
sourceRevision: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th edition, 2026 update; CODATA 2022 adjustment; IUPAC Green Book, 3rd edition, 2nd printing
sourceLocator: BIPM sections 2.2-2.3 and 5.4.8; CODATA Avogadro, molar gas, and Faraday entries; IUPAC amount, molar quantity, ideal-gas, and standard-pressure entries
caveats: All outputs are dependent conversions from declared inputs, not independent physical predictions.
Ideal-gas volume applies only under the stated model and temperature-pressure convention.

numericalMethod.name: Bounded molar dependency evaluation
numericalMethod.description: Evaluates four algebraic dependency paths over bounded finite controls, formats the large entity count in scientific notation, and emits no iterative or stochastic result.

modelComponents.label: Amount and entity-count identity
modelComponents.description: Maps declared amount n to the count N of specified entities through exact N_A.

caveats: The entity type must be specified outside the scalar conversion.

modelComponents.label: Molar-mass scaling
modelComponents.description: Maps amount to mass through the explicitly selected molar mass.

caveats: The engine does not infer composition or molar mass.

modelComponents.label: Declared-state ideal-gas volume
modelComponents.description: Maps amount to ideal-gas volume using chosen temperature and pressure model inputs; only the standard-atmosphere conversion 1 atm = 101325 Pa is exact.

attribution.sourceRevision: IUPAC Green Book, 3rd edition, 2nd printing; BIPM SI Brochure, 9th edition, 2026 update; CODATA 2022 adjustment
attribution.sourceLocator: IUPAC ideal-gas and standard-pressure entries; BIPM standard atmosphere conversion; CODATA molar gas constant
caveats: No non-ideal equation of state or composition correction is included.

modelComponents.label: Faraday charge scaling
modelComponents.description: Maps amount and signed charge number to charge through exact F = N_A e.

attribution.sourceRevision: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th edition, 2026 update; CODATA 2022 adjustment
attribution.sourceLocator: SI defining constants and CODATA Faraday constant
caveats: No reaction mechanism, yield, or current efficiency is modeled.

equations: F = N_A e; Q = z n F
assumptions: The elementary entity associated with amount n is explicitly specified by the learner's interpretation.
Molar mass M is a declared input and remains fixed while amount is scaled.
Gas output obeys pV = nRT with uniform equilibrium temperature and pressure.
Temperature and pressure are chosen model inputs; the standard preset uses the exact pressure conversion 1 atm = 101325 Pa but does not make an arbitrary T or p exact.
Charge number z is the signed number of elementary charges transferred per specified entity.
No empirical dataset, uncertainty propagation, non-ideal gas correction, or electrochemical efficiency is included.

controls.label: Substance preset
controls.description: Selects the engine's generic-particle path so the explicitly supplied molar mass is the sole mass basis.
controls.playfulPrompt: Keep the entity generic and make its molar mass explicit.

options.label: Generic particle
options.description: uses the declared molarMassKgPerMol engine input

controls.label: Amount of substance
controls.description: Sets the amount n shared by the entity-count, mass, ideal-gas, and Faraday conversions.
controls.playfulPrompt: Scale one declared amount and follow every dependent quantity.

controls.label: Gas model
controls.description: Selects the engine's ideal-gas branch for the conditional volume output.
controls.playfulPrompt: Keep the gas assumption visible beside its dependent volume.

controls.label: Gas temperature
controls.description: Sets the engine's bounded positive equilibrium temperature input for the ideal-gas branch.

controls.label: Gas pressure
controls.description: Sets the engine's bounded positive pressure input; the standard preset uses exactly 101325 Pa.

controls.label: Signed charge number per entity
controls.description: Sets integer z for Q = z n F; sign records the chosen charge-transfer direction convention.

controls.label: Declared molar mass
controls.description: Supplies the engine's required generic-particle molar mass; catalog composition is not inferred.

presets.label: Standard ideal gas
presets.description: Matches the engine preset: one mole of generic particles with chosen molar mass 0.02897 kg/mol and temperature 273.15 K at the exact conventional conversion 1 atm = 101325 Pa.
presets.inspectionPrompt: Identify the approximately 22.414 litre result as an ideal-gas conversion at a declared state, not a universal molar volume.

outputSchema.label: Amount of substance
outputSchema.description: Validated shared engine amount input n.

outputSchema.label: Specified entity count
outputSchema.description: Engine value N = n N_A; the interface must format it in scientific notation without claiming unit-by-unit floating-point precision.

outputSchema.label: Resolved molar mass
outputSchema.description: Engine-resolved generic-particle molar mass supplied by the explicit control.

outputSchema.label: Dependent mass
outputSchema.description: m = n M from the declared molar-mass input.

outputSchema.label: Dependent ideal-gas volume
outputSchema.description: V = n R T/p when gasModel is ideal; the engine type is nullable for its none branch.

outputSchema.label: Dependent Faraday charge
outputSchema.description: Q = z n F for the declared signed charge number per specified entity.

outputSchema.label: Optional per-particle energy
outputSchema.description: Null because this bounded activity does not expose the engine's optional perParticleEnergyJoule input.

outputSchema.description: Null when perParticleEnergyJoule is omitted, as it is in this activity.

outputSchema.label: Optional sample energy
outputSchema.description: Null when perParticleEnergyJoule is omitted, as it is in this activity.

outputSchema.label: Standard atmosphere convention
outputSchema.description: Engine constant 101325 Pa exactly, distinct from measured ambient pressure.

visualization.description: Shows amount as the shared root of count, mass, conditional ideal-gas volume, and Faraday charge branches, with the selected state attached to the gas branch.

alternatives.description: Reports the amount, formatted entity count, mass, declared gas state and ideal volume, signed Faraday charge, and each dependency caveat.
Lists each output with equation, numerical value, unit, direct inputs, assumptions, and dependent-conversion status.

visualization.reducedMotionBehavior: Render the complete dependency branches immediately without animated particle multiplication or scale transitions.

finding.changed: At runtime, changing amount is specified to scale count, mass, ideal-gas volume, and Faraday charge linearly; molar mass, state convention, and charge number affect only their declared branches.
finding.cause: The bounded outputs follow N = n N_A, m = n M, V = n R T/p, and Q = z n F.
finding.equation: N = n N_A; m = n M; V = n R T/p; F = N_A e; Q = z n F
assumptions: Specified elementary entity and amount of substance
Explicit molar mass held fixed during amount scaling
Ideal gas at chosen temperature and pressure inputs, with exactness reserved for the 101325 Pa standard-atmosphere conversion
Declared signed integer charge number with no efficiency model
finding.establishes: For an evaluated run, the bounded dependent values implied by the declared inputs, identities, ideal-gas model, state convention, and implementation revision.
finding.doesNotEstablish: A sample's composition, measured mass or volume, real-gas behavior, reaction completion, charge-transfer efficiency, or independent confirmation of any input relationship.
